opening.argument: The presentation reports that Immutable, King River Capital, and Polygon Labs established a $100 million Web3 gaming fund, placing the subject in a news-style account of industry activity. It explains that the fund targets “high-growth opportunities for professional and sophisticated investors in Web3 gaming” and that King River will manage the investment process and deploy capital across game studios and Web3 infrastructure firms. Historical context that the sector has attracted approximately $19 billion in investments further situates the discussion as market analysis. The presentation discusses investment opportunities and industry figures without directly asking viewers to transfer money, provide credentials, or join a specific transaction, while retaining opinion and research disclaimers.

citations.quote: Immutable, King River Capital, Polygon Labs Set Up $100M Web3 Gaming Fund
The IGF will target high-growth opportunities for professional and sophisticated investors in Web3 gaming
King River will manage the investment process and deploy the capital across game studios and Web3 infrastructure firms.
Since 2018, the sector has attracted approximately $19 billion in investments.
